title: List and total colorings of multiset permutation graphs
summary: Let $k$ and $\ell$ be positive integers. The multiset star transposition graph ST$_k^\ell$ has as vertices the $k\ell$-strings $v_0\cdots v_{k\ell-1}$ on $k$ symbols, each symbol repeated $\ell$ times, and edges given by the transpositions $(v_0\;v_i)$ with $v_i\ne v_0$ ($0 1$ and $\ell>2$ that ST$_k^\ell$ is $(\ell-1)$-choosable and that, as a result, admits total colorings.
